specific_objectives: 18.1.3.1 Trainee will be able to describe the basic theory of operation of surveillance system of an aircraft.

intro_questions: What is the primary function of a transponder in an aircraft?
How does a secondary surveillance radar differ from primary radar?
Why is the transponder system essential for modern air traffic control?
